description: User 'fredr', Windows 10 x64 build 19041 (20H2), hostname unknown. IP 192.168.1.5. Memory dump 2020-11-16 02:32:38 UTC (18 GB raw). MRC.exe (VB6, 32-bit, no-ASLR) launched from D:\Tools\ 83 seconds before dump. DLL LoadTime timestamps all zeroed (epochs 1600-1718) — temporal impossibility. SearchApp.exe (PID 8312) has 4 PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE regions — possible injected shellcode. SearchFilterHost (PID 24920) has ESTABLISHED TCP connection to 52.113.194.132:443 (Microsoft Azure) — unusual for indexing subprocess. Multiple cloud sync processes active: OneDrive, iCloud, Google Drive, Slack — exfiltration surface.

Written in Visual Basic 6 (MSVBVM60.DLL). 32-bit process on 64-bit system (Wow64=True). Base address 0x400000 — compiled without ASLR. artifacts.description: SearchApp.exe (PID 8312) has 4 PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE memory regions not backed by files on disk. Region 0x255fe730000: contains trampolining shellcode pattern — 'MOV RAX, addr; JMP RAX' (48 B8 xx xx xx xx; 48 FF E0) followed by INT3 padding. This is a classic position-independent shellcode stub used for code injection. SearchApp.exe is the Windows Search UWP process — code injection here provides access to the search stack shared with SearchFilterHost. No corresponding malfind hit on SearchFilterHost (PID 24920) but TCP ESTABLISHED to 52.113.194.132:443 observed — consistent with injected code using SearchApp as staging and SearchFilterHost as the C2 channel.

artifacts.description: SearchFilterHost.exe (PID 24920) has TCP ESTABLISHED connection to 52.113.194.132:443. SearchFilterHost is a Windows Search subprocess (child of SearchIndexer) — it processes search filter handlers for indexed content. This process does NOT initiate external network connections under normal operation. 52.113.194.132 resolves to Microsoft Azure — consistent with C2 using cloud infrastructure for traffic blending (living-off-the-cloud / TA0011). Connection timestamp: 2020-11-16 02:33:38 UTC — 60 seconds after memory dump, suggesting the connection was active during acquisition.
